FINAL IVX DEAL ORDER + ADMIN/FRONTEND SYNC FIX
EXECUTE NOW — DO NOT ONLY REPORT

CURRENT PRODUCTION BUG

Admin JV Deal Management order:

#1 PEREZ RESIDENCE
#2 Casa Rosario
#3 Jacksonville

Frontend order currently displays:

#1 Jacksonville
#2 Casa Rosario
#3 One Stop Development

This is incorrect.

The frontend must always follow the owner-controlled order from JV Deal Management.

There is also an active admin data bug:

- $NaN displayed
- ROI value missing
- Project names inconsistent between Admin and Frontend
- Perez Residence appears to be mapped incorrectly or replaced by another project

==================================================
OBJECTIVE
==================================================

Create one canonical production order and identity mapping:

Supabase canonical deal
→ Admin JV Deal Management
→ Home Featured Deals
→ Invest
→ Landing Page
→ Deal Details
→ Reels
→ Investor flow

Owner-defined order must be authoritative everywhere.

Required final order:

1. Perez Residence
2. Casa Rosario
3. Jacksonville

Do not sort public deals by:

- created_at
- updated_at
- published_at
- title
- database natural order
- API response order
- hardcoded array order

Sort only by:

display_order ASC

with a deterministic fallback only when display_order is missing.

==================================================
PHASE 1 — TRACE THE THREE RECORDS
==================================================

For each project return:

- canonical deal ID
- property ID
- slug
- official title
- public title
- developer name
- display_order
- published
- active
- database table
- API endpoint
- frontend card ID
- admin card ID

Trace exactly:

1. Perez Residence
2. Casa Rosario
3. Jacksonville

Do not join by title.
Use stable UUIDs.

==================================================
PHASE 2 — VERIFY DATABASE ORDER
==================================================

Query the canonical deal table directly.

Return:

deal_id
title
display_order
published
active
updated_at

Expected:

Perez Residence → 1
Casa Rosario → 2
Jacksonville → 3

If database values are wrong, correct them.

If duplicate display_order values exist, repair them.

Add or verify a constraint preventing invalid order values.

Rules:

- display_order must be a positive integer
- active published deals must not share the same display_order
- deleted/unpublished deals must not corrupt public ordering

==================================================
PHASE 3 — FIX ADMIN REORDER LOGIC
==================================================

Audit the up/down controls in JV Deal Management.

Required behavior:

- moving #3 up swaps only #2 and #3
- moving #1 down swaps only #1 and #2
- first item cannot move up
- last item cannot move down
- order change persists after app restart
- order change survives network reconnect
- order change updates database atomically
- failed reorder rolls back UI
- repeated taps do not create duplicate order values

Use a transaction or safe batch update.

Do not temporarily produce duplicate display_order values.

==================================================
PHASE 4 — FIX API SORTING
==================================================

Every public/admin deal endpoint must explicitly sort:

ORDER BY display_order ASC, updated_at DESC

Audit all endpoints used by:

- Home Featured Deals
- Invest
- Landing Page
- JV Deal Management
- Reels-linked cards
- Deal Details
- Investor flow

Return every file and query changed.

==================================================
PHASE 5 — REMOVE FRONTEND RESORTING
==================================================

Search the frontend for any secondary sorting.

Remove or correct:

- sort by created_at
- sort by title
- sort by published_at
- hardcoded priority arrays
- featured-first logic overriding display_order
- stale cached array ordering
- alphabetical sorting
- array index keys

The UI must use stable deal IDs as keys.

Do not use array index as the card key.

==================================================
PHASE 6 — CACHE INVALIDATION
==================================================

After reorder:

1. update database
2. invalidate admin query
3. invalidate public deals query
4. invalidate home feed query
5. invalidate landing deals cache
6. invalidate canonical deal cache
7. refetch visible screens
8. reject stale responses using updated_at/version
9. preserve scroll position
10. show a short “Order updated” confirmation

An older cached response must never overwrite the new order.

==================================================
PHASE 7 — FIX PROJECT IDENTITY MISMATCH
==================================================

Admin and frontend names must refer to the same canonical records.

Resolve these mismatches:

- Perez Residence
- Jacksonville Prime
- One Stop Constructors Inc
- One Stop Development LLC
- Casa Rosario

Return a mapping table:

CANONICAL DEAL ID
OFFICIAL PROJECT TITLE
PUBLIC TITLE
DEVELOPER LEGAL NAME
PROPERTY
DISPLAY ORDER

Do not overwrite production names until the mapping is verified.

==================================================
PHASE 8 — FIX $NaN AND ROI
==================================================

The Admin screen still shows:

$NaN
% ROI

Find the exact formatter and field mapping.

Audit:

- sale_price
- capital_required
- total_investment
- minimum_investment
- target_roi
- expected_roi
- roi_percent

Create one normalized deal view model.

Rules:

confirmed number → formatted value
confirmed zero → $0 or 0%
missing value → “Not entered”
invalid value → “Invalid data”

Never render:

NaN
undefined
null%
$undefined

Admin and frontend must use the same normalized fields.

==================================================
PHASE 9 — FULL ROUND-TRIP TEST
==================================================

Test this exact scenario:

A. Set order:
1 Perez Residence
2 Casa Rosario
3 Jacksonville

B. Save from Admin.

C. Close Admin completely.

D. Reopen Admin.

E. Confirm order remains 1,2,3.

F. Open Home.

G. Confirm order is 1,2,3.

H. Open Invest.

I. Confirm order is 1,2,3.

J. Open Landing Page.

K. Confirm order is 1,2,3.

L. Restart app.

M. Confirm order is still 1,2,3.

N. Change order to:
1 Casa Rosario
2 Perez Residence
3 Jacksonville

O. Confirm all public surfaces update.

P. Restore final required production order:
1 Perez Residence
2 Casa Rosario
3 Jacksonville

==================================================
PHASE 10 — AUTOMATED TESTS
==================================================

Add tests for:

- API returns display_order ASC
- admin reorder up
- admin reorder down
- first item cannot move up
- last item cannot move down
- atomic swap
- duplicate order prevention
- stale response rejection
- cache invalidation
- app restart persistence
- public/admin parity
- duplicate titles with different UUIDs
- missing display_order fallback
- unpublished deal exclusion
- $NaN prevention
- missing ROI handling

==================================================
FINAL ACCEPTANCE
==================================================

Do not mark complete until:

[ ] Admin order is Perez, Casa Rosario, Jacksonville.
[ ] Home order matches Admin.
[ ] Invest order matches Admin.
[ ] Landing order matches Admin.
[ ] Order survives restart.
[ ] Reorder propagates without stale cache.
[ ] Stable UUIDs are used.
[ ] No title-based joins remain.
[ ] No $NaN remains.
[ ] ROI displays correctly or “Not entered.”
[ ] Project names and developers match canonical records.
[ ] Tests pass.
[ ] Live screenshots prove parity.

==================================================

==================================================
